method: owner-supplied link; audio track extracted with yt-dlp, 30 s at 3240 s — the window whose loudness is the track's median (-25.1 dBFS over 162 windows, range -29.7 to -20.5)
why: The television soundscape scenario names a real bed. Mixing digital silence under the caller and calling it a television would measure nothing; this is continuous ambience with no silence above -35 dB across the source.
rights: The owner supplied the link and asked for it to be used as the ambience bed; the owner carries the rights decision for committing this excerpt.
notUsedFor: It is mixed under the caller's uplink at the scenario's declared level only. It is never evidence of Voni's own audio and never a reference for a property.
